" stmt-list / !((!stmt-list / term* "0"? term)* letter / (!'a') .+)? expr / &letter* "
"* ; factor <- term* factor / &"*" / "0" (letter &"
"?) ; expr <- (name_x "0"+ / "*" "
"? (!factor? " x " letter+)) name_x "0" ;
